Description: Enables student founders to configure campaign parameters, establish funding targets, configure timelines, and define structured milestone funding tranches. (Derived from FR-002, UC-01)
Acceptance Criteria: Campaign setup workflow validated with target, duration, and staged tranches.

Description: Provides backers with an intuitive checkout flow to select pledge amounts, pick reward tiers, and securely deposit funds into escrow. (Derived from FR-003, UC-02, UC-03, UC-04)
Acceptance Criteria: Pledge checkout operational with reward tier selection and PCI-DSS escrow authorization.

Description: Facilitates the submission of milestone deliverables by student founders and evaluation, approval, or rejection by faculty reviewers. (Derived from FR-004, UC-05, UC-06)
Acceptance Criteria: End-to-end evidence submission and faculty evaluation audit trail functioning.

Description: Controls the disbursement of escrowed funds to student founders upon successful milestone sign-off. (Derived from FR-001, UC-07, UC-04)
Acceptance Criteria: Automated escrow verification and gateway disbursement upon faculty sign-off.

Description: Keeps all stakeholders updated through automated alerts on milestones, disbursements, and campaign progress. (Derived from FR-005, UC-08)
Acceptance Criteria: Multi-channel notifications dispatched within 5 minutes and transparent public ledger visible.

Summary: Story 1.1: Campaign Target & Venture Overview Configuration
Description: As a Student Founder, I want to define my campaign title, pitch, category, and total funding target, so that potential backers understand the startup proposition and capital needs.
Acceptance Criteria: Given valid venture title, target amount (> 0), and description, when founder submits, draft campaign is initialized.

Description: As a Student Founder, I want to set the start and end dates for my campaign, so that the fundraising campaign is time-bound and builds momentum.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an active campaign creation form, when founder specifies start/end dates (duration between 14-60 days), dates are validated.

Description: As a Student Founder, I want to divide my project roadmap into distinct sequential milestones with individual funding tranches, so that funds can be disbursed in structured, verifiable phases.
Acceptance Criteria: Given campaign target T, sum of all milestone tranches must equal T, each having defined deliverables and due dates.

Description: As a Campaign Backer, I want to view available reward tiers and select one (or choose no reward) before confirming my contribution, so that I receive tangible incentives and perks.
Acceptance Criteria: Given active campaign with reward tiers, when backer pledges, chosen reward tier is logged on confirmation receipt.

Description: As a Campaign Backer, I want to authorize my payment via a PCI-DSS compliant gateway into platform escrow, so that my funds are protected until milestones are formally verified.
Acceptance Criteria: Given valid pledge amount, when payment is authorized, funds are locked in campaign escrow and auth token returned.

Description: As a Student Founder, I want to upload completion evidence (code repos, demonstration links, reports) for a due milestone, so that the faculty committee can evaluate actual progress.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an ongoing milestone, when founder attaches deliverables and submits, status changes to Under Review.

Description: As a Faculty Committee Member, I want to inspect submitted deliverables and record an Approve or Reject decision with evaluative comments, so that fund disbursement is justified.
Acceptance Criteria: Given assigned submission, reviewer decision, ID, timestamp, and comments are immutably logged.

Description: As a Student Founder, I want to review faculty rejection feedback and resubmit revised evidence before the revision deadline, so that I can rectify deficiencies without forfeiting the campaign.
Acceptance Criteria: Given Revision Requested status, when founder resubmits within deadline, review cycle resets to Under Review.

Description: As a System Service, I want to verify that escrow balance is sufficient and conditions are satisfied prior to release, so that fund releases never exceed collected pledges.
Acceptance Criteria: Given approved milestone, system validates escrow balance >= tranche amount before payment call.

Description: As a Student Founder, I want approved milestone funds to be transferred directly to my linked bank account, so that I have the required capital to execute the next project phase.
Acceptance Criteria: Given verified approval and escrow check, payout completes, milestone status updates to Released, and ledger updates.

Description: As a Student Founder and Backer, I want to receive automated email and in-app alerts whenever a milestone is approved, rejected, or a tranche is released, so that I stay informed within 5 minutes.
Acceptance Criteria: Given any milestone status change or payout, notifications are dispatched to all backers and founders within 5 mins.

Summary: Story 5.2: Public Campaign Ledger & Milestone Timeline
Description: As a Campaign Backer, I want to view a transparent milestone timeline and fund disbursement ledger, so that I can audit venture progress and fund allocation.
Acceptance Criteria: Given active/completed campaign, verified milestones and disbursed tranches are publicly visible on campaign timeline.
